Binary Search.intuition: Discard half of the search space at each step.

Fast & Slow Pointers.intuition: Two pointers moving at different speeds to detect cycles.

Merge Intervals.intuition: Sort by start time, then merge overlapping.

Cyclic Sort.intuition: Numbers from 1 to N belong at index i-1.
Cyclic Sort.whenToUse: Finding missing or duplicate numbers in a range.
Cyclic Sort.mistakes: Infinite swaps if duplicates are not handled.

Top K Elements (Heap).intuition: Maintain a min-heap of size K for the largest elements.

Subsets (Backtracking).intuition: Explore all possibilities by building solutions incrementally.
Subsets (Backtracking).mistakes: Forgetting to pop_back() to restore state.

Monotonic Stack.intuition: Maintain elements in strictly increasing/decreasing order.

Union Find (DSU).intuition: Groups elements into disjoint sets and merges them.

Sliding Window (Fixed).intuition: When the window size is fixed at k, add one element and remove one per step — recomputing from scratch is wasteful.
Sliding Window (Fixed).whenToUse: Max/min/average of every contiguous subarray of exactly size k. Keywords: 'subarray of length k', 'consecutive k elements'.
Sliding Window (Fixed).mistakes: Using variable window template when k is fixed; forgetting to subtract the element leaving; integer overflow when summing.

questions.name: Find All Anagrams in a String

Sliding Window (Variable).intuition: Expand right to explore, shrink left to restore validity. The window is always the largest valid sub-range ending at 'right'.
Sliding Window (Variable).whenToUse: Longest/shortest contiguous subarray/substring satisfying a constraint. Keywords: 'longest subarray with', 'minimum window', 'at most k distinct'.
Sliding Window (Variable).mistakes: Recording answer before shrinking; shrinking with 'if' instead of 'while'; not handling no-valid-window case.

Binary Search (Classic).intuition: Each comparison eliminates half the remaining search space. Maintain a clear invariant for what lo and hi represent.
Binary Search (Classic).whenToUse: Sorted arrays; first/last occurrence; rotated sorted arrays; peak element. Keywords: 'sorted', 'search target', 'find position'.
Binary Search (Classic).mistakes: Using mid=(lo+hi)/2 which overflows; wrong loop condition (< vs <=); off-by-one in boundary variants.

Binary Search on Answer.intuition: When you can check 'is X achievable?' in O(n), binary search on X. The answer space must be monotone: feasible for all values >= answer.
Binary Search on Answer.whenToUse: Minimize max / maximize min; allocation with constraints. Keywords: 'minimum speed', 'maximum pages', 'divide into k parts'.
Binary Search on Answer.mistakes: Wrong search space bounds; non-monotone feasibility check; overflow in feasibility check.

In-place Linked List Reversal.intuition: Re-wire next pointers iteratively using prev/curr/next trio. A dummy node avoids special-casing the head.
In-place Linked List Reversal.whenToUse: Reversing whole or partial linked lists; rotating; reorder list. Keywords: 'reverse', 'rotate', 'reorder', 'k-groups'.
In-place Linked List Reversal.mistakes: Losing reference to next before re-wiring; no dummy node; off-by-one in sublist boundaries.

BFS (Level Order).intuition: BFS explores level by level — naturally gives shortest paths in unweighted graphs and enables per-level processing in trees.
BFS (Level Order).whenToUse: Level-order tree problems; shortest path in unweighted graph/grid; minimum steps. Keywords: 'level', 'shortest path', 'minimum steps', 'word ladder'.
BFS (Level Order).mistakes: Not marking visited before pushing (duplicates); not snapshotting queue size (level blending); using DFS when shortest path is needed.

DFS (Tree).intuition: Post-order: children computed before parent (height, diameter). Pre-order: parent passes context down (path sum, bounds).
DFS (Tree).whenToUse: Tree height/depth; path sums; LCA; diameter; BST validation. Keywords: 'path', 'depth', 'height', 'ancestor', 'subtree'.
DFS (Tree).mistakes: Missing null base case; global variable not reset between tests; height vs depth confusion.

questions.name: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Tree

DFS (Graph / Backtracking).intuition: DFS explores deep before backtracking. Always restore state after recursion so each branch sees a clean slate.
DFS (Graph / Backtracking).whenToUse: Graph traversal; cycle detection; islands; all permutations/combinations; constraint satisfaction. Keywords: 'all paths', 'connected', 'islands', 'permutations'.
DFS (Graph / Backtracking).mistakes: Forgetting pop_back/undo; not marking visited before recursive call; visited array not cleared between paths.

questions.name: All Paths From Source to Target

Union-Find (DSU).intuition: DSU groups elements into disjoint sets. Path compression + union by rank gives near O(1) amortized (inverse Ackermann).
Union-Find (DSU).whenToUse: Dynamic connectivity; cycle detection; Kruskal's MST; accounts merge. Keywords: 'connected components', 'union', 'group', 'merge'.
Union-Find (DSU).mistakes: No path compression (O(n) find); no union by rank (degrades to chain); out-of-range element.

questions.name: Number of Connected Components in an Undirected Graph
Min Cost to Connect All Points

Topological Sort (Kahn's BFS).intuition: Process nodes with no remaining dependencies first. Reduce neighbors' in-degree each time. If all nodes processed, no cycle.
Topological Sort (Kahn's BFS).whenToUse: Dependency ordering; course scheduling; build systems; alien dictionary. Keywords: 'prerequisites', 'dependencies', 'before', 'schedule'.
Topological Sort (Kahn's BFS).mistakes: Wrong edge direction; not detecting cycles (size < n); not seeding all zero-indegree nodes.

questions.name: Find All Possible Recipes from Given Supplies

Trie.intuition: Shared prefixes share nodes. O(L) lookup regardless of dictionary size — far better than hashing for prefix queries.
Trie.whenToUse: Autocomplete; prefix matching; word search in board (with DFS). Keywords: 'prefix', 'autocomplete', 'dictionary', 'word search'.
Trie.mistakes: Forgetting isEnd = true; checking children before moving pointer; using map instead of array[26] for non-lowercase inputs.

Two Heaps.intuition: Partition stream into lower/upper halves. The median lives at the boundary of a max-heap (lower) and min-heap (upper).
Two Heaps.whenToUse: Running median; sliding window median. Keywords: 'median', 'running median', 'sliding window median'.
Two Heaps.mistakes: Not rebalancing after insertion; not checking cross-heap ordering; integer overflow when averaging.

K-way Merge.intuition: Always pick the globally smallest current element from k sources. A min-heap of size k makes each pick O(log k).
K-way Merge.whenToUse: Merging k sorted lists/arrays; smallest range; Kth smallest in matrix. Keywords: 'merge k sorted', 'k lists', 'smallest range'.
K-way Merge.mistakes: Initializing heap with all elements (defeats purpose); not storing source index; not checking bounds before pushing next.

Subsets / Backtracking.intuition: Decision tree: at each element, include or exclude. Backtracking prunes branches that can't reach a valid answer.
Subsets / Backtracking.whenToUse: All subsets/combinations/permutations; combinatorial search. Keywords: 'all subsets', 'combinations', 'power set', 'k elements'.
Subsets / Backtracking.mistakes: Missing pop_back; iterating from 0 instead of start (duplicate subsets); not sorting before skipping duplicates in Subsets II; reuse allowed = pass i, no reuse = pass i+1.

questions.name: Letter Combinations of a Phone Number

DP - 0/1 Knapsack.intuition: Every item is either taken or not. Reversing the inner loop prevents using the same item twice (distinguishes from unbounded knapsack).
DP - 0/1 Knapsack.whenToUse: Capacity budget, each item used once; partition equal subset; target sum. Keywords: 'capacity', 'weight', 'at most', 'exactly', 'partition'.
DP - 0/1 Knapsack.mistakes: Forward inner loop (allows reuse); wrong initialization; base case dp[0] not set.

DP - Unbounded Knapsack.intuition: Forward inner loop: dp[w - coin] already reflects current coin being used, enabling unlimited reuse.
DP - Unbounded Knapsack.whenToUse: Unlimited copies per denomination; minimum coins; number of ways to make change. Keywords: 'unlimited', 'any number of times', 'coins', 'denominations'.
DP - Unbounded Knapsack.mistakes: Reversing inner loop (turns into 0/1); wrong dp[0] init; overflow when adding large counts.

DP - LCS / LIS.intuition: LCS: match from ends of both strings. LIS: maintain smallest possible tail for each IS length via binary search.
DP - LCS / LIS.whenToUse: LCS: align sequences; edit distance; shortest common supersequence. LIS: envelope nesting; patience sorting. Keywords: 'common subsequence', 'increasing subsequence', 'edit distance'.
DP - LCS / LIS.mistakes: LCS off-by-one; O(n^2) LIS when n is large; confusing subsequence with subarray.

DP - Interval / Matrix Chain.intuition: Split interval [i,j] at every 'last' pivot k. Best answer = solve left + solve right + cost at k. Must build up from small intervals to large.
DP - Interval / Matrix Chain.whenToUse: Burst balloons; stone merge; matrix chain; palindrome partition; strange printer. Keywords: 'burst', 'merge', 'split optimally', 'palindrome partition'.
DP - Interval / Matrix Chain.mistakes: Not iterating by length first; wrong k bounds (k must be strictly inside [i,j]); wrong 'last' vs 'first' semantics.

Bit Manipulation.intuition: XOR cancels pairs. AND isolates bits. n & (n-1) clears the lowest set bit. These primitives solve many 'find the odd-one-out' and 'subset enumeration' problems in O(1) extra space.
Bit Manipulation.whenToUse: Unique elements; power of 2 checks; bitmask DP; counting bits; in-place swap. Keywords: 'single number', 'subset bitmask', 'XOR', 'power of 2'.
Bit Manipulation.mistakes: Overflow: use 1LL << i for i >= 31; operator precedence: (n >> i) & 1 not n >> (i & 1); confusing & with &&.
